{{Quote|Master Lowbacca wishes to inquire whether that island up ahead is our final destination.''"<br />"''Yes, that is Reef Fortress.|[[M-TD]], Lowbacca's [[Translator droid/Legends|translator droid]], and Ta'a Chume|<ref name="Lightsabers" />}}
'''Reef Fortress Island''' was an island on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hapes/Legends|Hapes]]. In [[23 ABY/Legends|23 ABY]], [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi trainees]] [[Tenel Ka Djo|Tenel Ka]], [[Lowbacca]], and [[Darth Caedus|Jacen]] and [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] sought refuge in [[Reef Fortress]], which was located on the island, because a bomb had [[Bombing of Fountain Palace|gone off]] in [[Fountain Palace]], the royal residence of the [[Queen Mother]] of Hapes, where they had previously been staying. While there, the youths escaped [[carnivorous seaweed]] and [[Death/Legends|killed]] [[Bartokk]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]], thereby thwarting [[Ambassador/Legends|Ambassador]] [[Yfra]]'s plot to kill the [[Hapan]] [[Matriarch/Legends|matriarch]], [[Ta'a Chume]], and overthrow the Hapan [[Hapan Royal House|monarchy]]. In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], a [[Honor duel on Hapes|duel]] was held between [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Isolder]] and [[Archon (Vergill)|Archon]] [[Beed Thane]] on Reef Fortress Island. Isolder won the duel, and, as a result, the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]] joined the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in the [[Yuuzhan Vong War|war]] against the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] invaders.

==Description==
Reef Fortress Island was a small island in an [[Unidentified Hapan ocean|ocean]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hapes/Legends|Hapes]]. It was near [[Dragon's Teeth]], a group of sharp rocks jutting out of the [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]]. It was surrounded by reefs<ref name="Lightsabers" /> and was only accessible by [[Boat/Legends|boat]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|88|Reef Fortress}}</ref> Wild [[Dewberry|dewberries]] grew on the island,<ref name="Jedi Eclipse">''[[The New Jedi Order: Agents of Chaos II: Jedi Eclipse]]''</ref> and it had a small cove that was good for swimming. The island got its name from [[Reef Fortress]], a private shoreside retreat of the [[Hapan Royal House|Royal Family of Hapes]] that served as a stronghold in [[Time/Legends|times]] of emergency, which was located on the island. Near the [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]] was a [[Power generator/Legends|generator]] station that provided it with power and a [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]].<ref name="Lightsabers" />

==History==
{{Quote|I can't wait to show you my home.|Tenel Ka, to Jacen, Jaina, and Lowbacca, regarding Reef Fortress Island|<ref name="Lightsabers" />}}
[[Tenel Ka Djo|Tenel Ka]], the [[Hapan]] [[Prince/Legends|princess]], spent some time with her [[Parent/Legends|parents]] on Reef Fortress Island as a young [[Gender/Legends|girl]]. Later, in [[23 ABY/Legends|23 ABY]], Tenel Ka, along with her friends and fellow [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi trainees]] [[Lowbacca]], [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]], and [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], sought refuge on the island after a bomb went off in the Hapan [[Matriarch/Legends|matriarch's]] royal residence, [[Fountain Palace]], where they had been staying. The matriarch's personal [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]], [[Yfra]], and some [[Hapan Royal Guard|Hapan Honor Guards]] accompanied the youths to the island to watch over and protect them. During their stay there, Tenel Ka, Lowbacca, Jacen, and Jaina spent some time swimming in a small cove that Tenel Ka knew of from her earlier vacations on the island. At the suggestion of Yfra, the friends took a trip out on the ocean in a [[Hapan Water Dragon|wavespeeder]] that she, unbeknownst to them, had programmed to go into an area of dangerous [[carnivorous seaweed]]. Yfra hoped to use the [[Seaweed/Legends|seaweed]] to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the youths as part of her plot to overthrow the Hapan Royal Family. The young [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were able to escape from the seaweed using their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] and [[Knife/Legends|knives]], and Jaina and Lowbacca manually [[Pilot/Legends|drove]] the wavespeeder back to the island.<ref name="Lightsabers" />

Later, [[Ta'a Chume]], who was the Hapan matriarch and Tenel Ka's grandmother, arrived at the island in her own royal wavespeeder. That night, [[Bartokk]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] arrived at the island in an [[Assault vehicle/Legends|assault craft]] and [[Raid on Reef Fortress|invaded]] Reef Fortress after destroying the [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generator]] and cutting off power to the fortress. The assassins, who were sent by Yfra to kill the matriarch, trapped Ta'a Chume in her [[Sleeper (furniture)|bedchamber]]. Jacen, Jaina, Lowbacca, and Tenel Ka saved the matriarch by helping her climb out the [[Window/Legends|window]] of her bedchamber. They then found a small wavespeeder and fled the island, with the assassins following in their assault craft. Jaina and Lowbacca, who were piloting the wavespeeder, decided to drive into Dragon's Teeth in the hope that the assassins would crash on the rocks. After this failed, they steered the wavespeeder into some carnivorous seaweed, which killed the assassins who were following them. Ta'a Chume then drove the wavespeeder to Fountain Palace and arrested Yfra before she could promote herself as the [[Queen Mother|monarch]].<ref name="Lightsabers" />

In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], [[Isolder]], the [[Chume'da|Prince of Hapes]], and [[Beed Thane]], the [[Archon (Vergill)|Archon]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] planet [[Vergill]], which was a member of the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]], participated in an [[honor duel]] at Reef Fortress on Reef Fortress Island. Isolder initiated the [[Honor duel on Hapes|duel]] by slapping Thane across the face for insulting New Republic Ambassador [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] and Tenel Ka, who was Isolder's daughter. Isolder won the duel during a sudden death round that the [[Unidentified referee|referee]] had called. As a result of the duel, the Hapes Consortium decided to enter the [[Yuuzhan Vong War|war]] against the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] invaders.<ref name="Jedi Eclipse" />

==Behind the scenes==
Reef Fortress Island first appeared in ''[[Young Jedi Knights: Lightsabers]]'', a young reader's novel by [[Kevin J. Anderson]] and [[Rebecca Moesta]] that was published in [[1996]]. It later appeared in the [[2000]] novel ''[[The New Jedi Order: Agents of Chaos II: Jedi Eclipse]]'', by [[James Luceno]], and was also mentioned in the entry for "Reef Fortress" in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', published in [[2008]].
